title: Tensor normalization of scalar extension and pullback before taking mates
statement: Let f : Z → T be any scheme morphism and a : A → B a map of commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site of T. Write U = f_A^*, r_T and r_Z for exact derived scalar restriction, T_T and T_Z for derived scalar extension, b : r_Z ∘ f_B^* ≅ U ∘ r_T for the canonical restriction/pullback comparison, lambda : f_B^* ∘ T_T ≅ T_Z ∘ U for the prescribed inverse scalar mate, C_T = r_T(B)[0] and C_Z = r_Z(f^{-1}B)[0]. For any normalized tensor presentations t,z, let e_T : r_T T_T ≅ (- ⊗^L C_T), e_Z : r_Z T_Z ≅ (- ⊗^L C_Z), c : U C_T ≅ C_Z be the fixed degree-zero coefficient identification, and mu : U(M ⊗^L N) ≅ UM ⊗^L UN the normalized tensor comparison. For every M in D(A), b^{-1}_{T_T M} ≫ r_Z(lambda_M) ≫ e_{Z,UM} ≫ (1 ⊗ c^{-1}) = U(e_{T,M}) ≫ mu_{M,C_T}. There are no flatness or boundedness assumptions. This identity involves only pullback and scalar extension, before taking a geometric mate.

proof.text: On a flat-term K-flat complex P, postcompose both desired maps with tensor(d_P,derivedCoefficientPullback.hom), followed by the one-sided scalar coordinates. This is invertible because the scalar-derived counit is invertible on pulled-back K-flat complexes. Naturality of derivedTensorIso moves d_P to the scalar-extension side. The scalar ordinary route and the proved one-sided tensor pullback identify the two composites with the same localized ordinary total map. Cancel the postcomposition.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPullback_tensor_normalization
    {Z T : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ T)
    {A B : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1}} (a : A ⟶ B)
    (t : ProEtaleTensorModel T A) (z : ProEtaleTensorModel Z (inverseRing f A))
    (M : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules T A)) :
    (proEtaleRingRestrictionDerivedPullback f A B (inverseRing f A) (inverseRing f B)
        a (inverseMap f a) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp)).inv.app
          ((proEtaleRingDerivedExtension a).obj M) ≫
      (restriction (inverseMap f a)).mapDerivedCategory.map ((scalarPullback f a).hom.app M) ≫
      (derivedTensorIso (inverseMap f a) z).hom.app ((pull f A).obj M) ≫
      z.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (derivedCoefficientPullback f a).inv) =
    (pull f A).map ((derivedTensorIso a t).hom.app M) ≫
      (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f A (inverseRing f A) (Iso.refl _) t z).hom.app
        (M, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (coefficientComplex a))
